messages:
Jia: Heads up — I'm starting a focused playbook for the long-lived slice refactor of session-controller. Proposal: split into session-core (hotpath, auth, routing) and session-enricher (enrichments, lookups, non-blocking hooks). Gate each extract with contract tests + 7d shadowing before any route weights change.
Ben: +1 on the split. Question: how do we enforce the contract? unit tests won't catch timing/KV consistency. thinking: a contract runner that replays real traffic samples against both services and diffs responses (fuzzy compare). @Caro any observability requirements here? :eyes:
Caro: We need tracing preserved across the proxy boundary and metrics parity for p95/p99. Also capture sampling of full requests for the diff runner (scrubbed). I'd add a regression alert if avg latency increases >10% on the hotpath during shadowing. Also: make sure logs include the correlation id and the service tag so the diff tool can align events.
Jia: Agreed. Drafted a minimal traffic config to start canaries/shadowing; will drop into deploy templates. Example stub:
```
traffic_control:
  canary:
    service: session-core
    weight: 0.1
  shadow:
    service: session-enricher
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 1.0
contract_runner:
  sample_window: 1h
  compare_mode: tolerant_fuzzy
  scrub_fields: ["user.email","ip"]
```
Use feature flag `feature.session_split_v1` to flip the route.
Ben: That helps. For KV migration (prefix cache), plan is to have dual-read for 2 weeks and background backfill. What's the cost profile? If dual-read spikes RPS we need autoscale rules.
Mike: Good point — add a budget check in the playbook. Before any 10% canary we run a simulated load test (prod-sim) that exercises dual-read. We should also add a cost/throughput checkpoint in the rollout checklist so PMs sign off.
Caro: Also add a quality gate: run the eval harness (our prompt/eval infra) against the enriched path to detect regressions in downstream features that depend on enrichment. If regression > 1% failure, halt.
Jia: Updated checklist (high-level):
- extract thin adapter + compile public interface (README of endpoints)
- implement contract_runner and wire into CI (non-blocking)
- start 0% route, enable shadowing for 7d, run contract diffs daily
- perf sim with dual-read; autoscale tweak if needed
- canary 10% for 24h, monitor p95/p99, cost
- escalate to rollback if contract diffs > threshold or latency regresses
Ben: Who owns the contract_runner? I can take the initial spike, then hand to test infra for ownership.
Jia: Thanks — assigning Ben for contract_runner spike. Caro owns observability bits. Mike owns rollout checklist + cost signoff. I'll do the adapter extract + README. I'll open tickets in GH and link them here.
Infra-bot: deploy-bot started canary: session-core v2 -> 10% (id: canary-173555)
Jia: quick note — ensure we have a fallback policy to route to legacy session-controller if enricher times out. Add timeouts: 150ms for enrich path by default.
Caro: I'll add tracing and an APM dashboard template. Also adding regression alerts and a comparator dashboard for contract diffs.
Mike: Sounds like a plan. Let's sync Monday for the first spike review. @Ben bring the initial runner PR, @Jia bring the adapter README. :thumbsup:
